tweets.text:
$1.99 trillion. That is the official U.S. budget deficit for fiscal 2026.

Not during a crisis or pandemic.

Just a standard fiscal year running a 6.2% deficit to GDP.

The real story is debt service. Net interest payments surged 12% to a record $1.36 trillion, topping almost every domestic line item except Social Security.

Total public debt crossed $40 trillion two months ago.

Debate rate cuts all you want. When the sovereign issuer spends $1.3 trillion a year just servicing past debt, compounding math has taken the wheel.

That is why we Bitcoin.

Most guys hope for a watch on their wedding day. This groom in China was handed an RTX 5090 and broke down in real tears.

Between import curbs and gray market premiums, that box likely cost five figures. Dowries used to be gold and property. Now it is high-end silicon.

Pundits can write all the threads they want about chip cycles peaking. Down on the ground, consumer demand is still powerful enough to cause emotional collapses at the altar.

Hard to look at scenes like this and think the appetite for flagship compute has topped out.

Via Reddit: r/JustGuysBeingDudes (u/LazyGuy4U)
Unrealized gains aren't real money. Nobody goes broke taking profits, but plenty go broke waiting for the exact top. Have an exit plan.

tweets.text:
突然有点感慨，还记得 2018 年神鱼 @bitfish 在群里发 Cobo 云红包，还有当年大家薅 PAX 羊毛的日子。

那时候的 Crypto 圈，每天都有新鲜事，一个红包、一点羊毛都能让大家兴奋半天。

一晃九年过去了，行业几经牛熊，当年的玩法和产品不断变迁。如今 Cobo Wallet App 也即将谢幕。

怀念的不只是一个钱包，更是那个充满机会、大家一起折腾的 Crypto 年代。

九年 Cobo，九年行业。感谢那些曾经参与过、见证过的日子。

祝 Cobo 生日快乐，也祝当年一起抢红包、薅羊毛的老朋友们，都还在牌桌上。

💡 Cobo Wallet App 即将关停：一家加密钱包公司的九年转型史

Cobo Wallet App 将于 2026 年 12 月 1 日正式关闭服务。用户需在 11 月 30 日 23:59 前转出全部资产，否则后续将按月收取账户管理费：余额的 2%，每月最低等值 100 美元。

在 Cobo 成立九周年之际，这一消息也让人重新审视这家加密基础设施公司的发展轨迹。

从服务个人用户的钱包，到机构级托管，再到 AI Agent 支付，Cobo 走过了怎样的九年？

1/ 2017—2019：从个人钱包起步

2017 年，神鱼与蒋长浩博士创立 Cobo，最初聚焦数字资产的安全存储。

2018 年，Cobo 完成 1,300 万美元 A 轮融资，并拓展 PoS Staking 等业务；2019 年，推出 WaaS（Wallet-as-a-Service），开始将钱包能力转化为面向企业的基础设施。

这一步，为后来的业务转型埋下了伏笔。

2/ 2021：加速机构化

2021 年，Cobo 完成 4,000 万美元 B 轮融资，由 DST Global 等机构领投。

随着加密行业走向机构化，数字资产管理的需求不再局限于存储，还涉及资产托管、交易签名、权限管理和链上资金流转。

Cobo 的业务也逐步向机构级托管与钱包基础设施延伸，布局全托管、MPC 和智能合约钱包等解决方案。

3/ 从钱包产品到基础设施

对于机构而言，钱包不只是一个查看余额、转账的 App，更是连接交易、托管、DeFi 和支付的关键基础设施。

Cobo 持续拓展 WaaS、MPC 等技术与服务，试图解决企业在私钥安全、多人审批、资产管理和链上操作中的复杂问题。

竞争的核心，也从用户体验延伸到了安全能力、系统集成与机构服务。

4/ 2026：AI Agent 成为新变量

在九周年创始人访谈中，神鱼与蒋长浩谈到了 AI 对组织管理、产品开发和安全体系的影响。

Cobo 也将业务愿景延伸至人类与 AI Agent 的钱包和支付基础设施，并探索 Agentic Wallet 等方案。

当 AI Agent 开始拥有执行任务、调用工具乃至发起交易的能力，新的问题随之出现：

如何授权？如何限制交易权限？如何确保资产安全？

这些问题，恰好与钱包基础设施的核心能力相交汇。

5/ Cobo Wallet App 关停，意味着什么？

从个人钱包到机构基础设施，再到 AI Agent 支付，Cobo 的业务重心经历了明显变化。

但需要注意，官方公告目前并未披露 App 关停的具体原因，因此不能直接认定这是战略转型的必然结果，也不意味着 Cobo 整家公司停止运营。

真正值得观察的是：在消费级钱包产品退出后，Cobo 能否继续依靠机构托管、钱包技术和支付基础设施建立竞争优势。

九年里，产品形态可以变化，但安全与信任始终是钱包业务的底层命题。

tweets.text:
Wrapped zkAPI + Tor + extra cover traffic + local LLM prompt rewriting in an open-AI compatible daemon, and made a "paranoid mode" wrapper for my agent harness (pi):

Each conversation gets assigned a separate Tor circuit, your requests are masked with random cover traffic, zkAPI ensures you don't leak your identity through payments, and all prompts are locally rewritten (bring-your-own-local-model; I'm using qwen3.8-flash-next)

https://t.co/MepCFCrLv1

My agent harness is wrapped with a bwrap sandbox (also experimenting with MicroVM) and wrapped again with torsocks, so everything it does goes through Tor.

Here's what me asking it to do a simple research task looks like.

It's getting quite usable! Though you definitely still pay quite a bit in increased latency, especially when starting a new conversation.

Also, Tor is far from optimal here for privacy; the cover traffic mechanism is okay against passive adversaries but much weaker if the LLM provider is colluding with the guard and actively manipulating timing. This kind of task really requires a more specialized mixnet, probably take the tradeoff of a higher bandwidth multiplier and built-in constant cover traffic.

Also also, much cheaper zkAPI deposit and withdraw gas costs are coming to mainnet soon.

Saw some comments about my post on this topic 👇 🤣 

1. I am always supportive of any blockchain making any progress in any country. BTC, ETH, BNB, XRP, SOL, HYPE, ZEC, SIGN, all stablecoins, etc, you name it...

2. I was happy that SOL can advertise and get an office in Shanghai. It would open the path for others to follow. It would also indicate that "China unbanned crypto", which would be positive news for all of us. But alas, that's not quite the case yet, it seems...

3. My X post was not the trigger. It's now emerged that the Bund building ad was taken down within 10 minutes. (If you don't know, China monitors speech and media in real-time.) I only saw it on X 12-24 hours after the fact. 

4. Regardless of the outcome, it's good effort. Keep building and keep pushing adoption.
Sad to see. Looks like they really didn't know the local policies? But it's not the first time either, same thing happened less than a year ago: https://t.co/c2lI8p2r9w https://t.co/n2Zv1hpIyZ
